strings.(구름 한 점 없는 맑은 하늘, 그 위에 떠 있는 따사로운 햇살이 리프트: (Warm sunlight from a clear, cloudless sky shines on Lifthrasir's plaza.)
I wanted a good night's sleep...
strings.(벤치에 앉아 고개를 뒤로 젖히고 하늘을 바라보던 %s의 시야에 장난기: (Sitting on a bench with your head tilted back toward the sky, you see a mischievous elf enter %s's field of vision.)
strings.쉬고 있었군요. 제가 방해한 건 아니겠죠?: So you were resting. I hope I wasn't interrupting.
It's all right. As you suggested, simply resting does feel nice.
No. It's just that I have a lot on my mind.
strings.아실지 모르겠지만…. 저는 여행을 하면서 많은 일들을 겪었어요. 잘 해결: You may already know... I've experienced many things on my travels. Some worked out well, but others remain unresolved.
strings.고민이 많군요. 당장 뭔가 해결하겠다고 너무 무리하지는 말아요. 언젠가: You have many worries. Don't push yourself too hard trying to solve everything right now. Some things work themselves out when the time is right.
That's true. But perhaps because I'm impatient, it isn't easy.
Try to let go of those lingering uneasy feelings.
strings.아, 맞다. 소장님은 어디 다녀오셨어요?: Oh, right. Where have you been, Director?
Out for a little walk. I made a circuit of the forest and the village. Hehe.
You look so silly slumped there. It's delightful.
Sometimes you say such harsh things so naturally, Director. It's almost admirable.
I'll take that as a compliment. Hehe.
strings.%s, 잠시만요. 할 이야기가 있으니 여기 말고 우리 집 앞으로 오시겠어: %s, a moment. There's something I'd like to discuss. Would you come to the front of my house?
strings.(방금 전까지 장난치듯 환하게 대화를 이어가던 리프의 표정이 굳어져 있다: (Lif's expression, so bright and playful moments ago, has hardened.)
strings.%s에게는 제 말이 이상할 수도 있지만, 리프트라시르에서 오래 지낸 저는: That may sound strange to you, %s, but after living in Lifthrasir for so long, I can feel the forest.
You mean you can sense something like the forest's energy?
strings.확인을 좀 해봐야겠는데…. %s, 잠깐 시간 돼요?: I should check... %s, do you have a moment?
strings.여기에 무슨 문제 있어요? 아…. 저번엔 안 보였는데, 지금 꽃잎의 색이: Is something wrong here? Oh... I didn't see this last time, but the petals have changed color. Why...?
strings.수정달 숲의 나뭇잎과 꽃잎은 제가 태어날 때부터 지금까지 색이 변한 적이: The leaves and petals of the Crystal Moon Forest have never changed color, from the day I was born until now.
strings.오래전 마족들이 이곳을 탐냈을 때도 멀쩡했는데…. 지금은 꽃 몇 송이 정: They were fine even when demons coveted this place long ago... It's only a few flowers now, but the number will grow.
strings.누가 숲에 이런 짓을 한 걸까요?: Who could have done this to the forest?
strings.제가 지금에야 느낄 수 있을 정도였니까…. 흐음, 누가 대체… 후우,: If I only noticed it now... Hmm. Who on earth... Sigh, I don't know.
strings.일단 누군지 알아내는 것보다 빨리 나무와 꽃의 색을 되돌리는 게 좋겠어요: For now, restoring the trees and flowers should come before finding the culprit. The method is simple, but there's a problem.
We need the energy of a tree that retains the power of spirits. From another region, not here.
strings.오르카리움? 준신이었던 오르카를 기다리던 장소죠? 구전으로 내려오는 장소: Orcarium? The place that awaited Orca, who was a demigod? I thought it existed only in oral tradition. How remarkable that it's real.
strings.거기라면 제대로 된 기운을 받아올 수 있을 것 같아요. 몇 곳을 탐색해야: We should be able to obtain the right energy there, though we may have to search several places.
strings.그런데 그 정령의 기운이란 걸 어떻게 받아오죠?: But how do we bring back this spirit energy?
strings.마력이 깃든 물건에서 마력이 빠져나가지 못하게 하는 일종의 마력 종이가: There is a kind of magic paper that prevents magic from escaping an enchanted object.
strings.마법청 물건인 것 같은데, 이거 써도 괜찮은 건가요?: It looks like something from the Magic Bureau. Is it safe to use?
It's all right. Its safety is guaranteed, so both the empire and Alfheim use it from time to time.
strings.아, 네. 그럼 절 따라오세요. 여기서 바로 가는 길을 몰라서 크노소스를: Oh, right. Follow me, then. I don't know a direct route from here, so we'll go through Knossos.
strings.나름 위기 상황인데, 왜 즐거워하시는 거 같죠?: This is something of a crisis, so why do you seem to be enjoying yourself?
It'll be wonderful if the flowers and trees recover.
Who knows? I suppose I'm simply happy to go out.
strings.(진짠가…. 하도 그래서 어느게 진짜인지 모르겠네.): (Really...? She does this so often I can't tell what's sincere.)
strings.(아…. 오르카리움에 가려면 먼저 캠프를 지나가야 하겠지.): (Oh... We'll have to pass through the camp to reach Orcarium.)
Yawn... I'm sleepy. And hungry... Why is there nothing to eat here...?
strings.아직 있었다뇨? 모험가님, 언제 이곳에 오신 적이 있으신가요?: Still here? Adventurer, have you been here before?
And where did you come from? Every passage into this place has been blocked.
Well, you must have found some way.
strings.제국법에 의거, 현재 이곳은 마법청과 관련된 인물이 아니면 지나가실 수: Under imperial law, only people connected with the Magic Bureau may pass through here at present.
Please wait until the other members of the Bureau arrive.
Wait, Feta. What are you talking about? I've been here before.
This is the first time I've seen you here...
Huh... What? I was definitely captured by No Name...
No Name was asking how he had survived, then said he was going to catch a witch...
strings.왜 내 기억이 뒤죽박죽이지?: Why are my memories all mixed up?
...It's not as though I met a witch.
strings.아! 배고파서 그런가?: Oh! Is it because I'm hungry?
strings.(페타의 기억이 왜곡됐어. 나르샤와 내가 떠나고 있었던 일이 진짠지 아닌: (Feta's memories have been distorted. I don't know whether what happened after Narsha and I left was real...)
strings.%s, 혹시 오르카리움에 마녀가 나타났어요?: %s, did a witch appear in Orcarium?
strings.거기 엘프는 무슨 일로 여기 오셨나요? 여기는 아무나 올 수 있는 곳이…: You there, elf. What brings you here? This isn't a place just anyone can...
strings.잠깐 여기를 탐색할 수 있게 도와주시겠어요?: Could you help us investigate here for a little while?
strings.허가가 있어야 하는데…. 지금 모험가님도 다시 들어갈 수 없습니다. 아무: You need permission... Even the adventurer can't enter again right now. Even with His Majesty's orders... Ugh. Ah... I'm hungry.
strings.(인상을 쓰며 주린 배를 붙잡고 있는 페타를 보며 리프가 재미있다는 표정: (Lif looks amused at Feta clutching her empty stomach with a grimace.)
strings.리프트라시르에서 만든 특제 쿠키가 잔뜩 있는데, 어때요? 하나 먹어 볼래: I have lots of special cookies made in Lifthrasir. What do you say? Want to try one?
strings.(리프가 고개를 끄덕이면서 작은 봉투에 손을 넣는다.): (Lif nods and reaches into a small bag.)
strings.엘프는 이런 봉투가 많이 있는 거예요?: Do elves have lots of bags like that?
strings.후후, 많지는 않지만 드물게 가지고 있긴 해요. 자, 마법사님. 잠깐 조: Hehe, not many, but some of us have them. Now, Ms. Mage. Help us do a quick investigation, and I'll give you lots of Alfheim cookies.
strings.(페타가 진지하게 고민한다. 하지만, 그것도 잠시뿐, 페타가 눈앞에 흔들: (Feta considers it seriously. But only for a moment: she takes the cookie waving before her eyes and bites into it.)
Of course. Here. You can eat them all.
strings.(리프가 포장한 별빛 쿠키 상자를 잔뜩 내놓자 페타가 감탄한다.): (Feta gasps in admiration as Lif sets out numerous wrapped boxes of Starlight Cookies.)
strings.(먹는 거에 저렇게 쉽게 넘어가서 본청으로 갈 수 있겠어? 후우. 그건: (Will she ever make it to headquarters if food wins her over so easily? Sigh. Speaking of which, I should take Michaela some Starlight Cookies sometime.)
strings.%s, 오르카리움에 가본 장소 중에서 특이한 곳이 있으면 그곳으로 안내해: %s, if there's an unusual place among the parts of Orcarium you've visited, take me there.
strings.모험가님을 만나서 깬 거 같아요. 우리가 그랬던 것처럼…. 크게 문제는: It seems meeting you woke her up, as it did us... I don't see any major problem. She's a Magic Bureau mage. She'll manage. Hehe.
strings.(리프 소장님 말씀대로 내버려 두면 괜찮아질까? 그래도 좀 이상해. 리프: (Will she recover if we leave her alone, as Director Lif says? Still, it's strange. How did what happened in Lifthrasir affect things all the way here...?)
strings.(여러 가지 생각을 하고 있던 %s의 뒤로 알 수 없는 그림자가 드리운다: (As %s turns over many thoughts, an unknown shadow falls behind you. A gentle touch, accompanied by someone's strangely familiar power...)
strings.(검은 그림자는 %s의 시야를 잠식하듯 점점 커져간다.): (The black shadow grows, as though swallowing %s's sight.)
strings.(리프의 목소리에 모험가가 등을 돌리는 순간, 주위를 가득 채운 검은 그: (The moment the adventurer turns at Lif's voice, the black shadow filling the surroundings scatters like bubbles.)
You look a little tired. I'm sorry. It's because of me...
strings.(내가 잘못들은 건 아니겠지….): (I didn't imagine hearing that, did I...?)
Sigh... Director, let's finish quickly and leave this place.
All right. If you feel unwell along the way, tell me at once.
strings.(%s의 발걸음이 노네임을 만났었던 오르카리움의 한적한 곳에 멈춘다.): (%s stops in the quiet part of Orcarium where you met No Name.)
Is this where you met that boy? You've really been through a great deal, %s.
strings.여행자들에게 길을 알려주던 정령이 그렇게 됐다는 것도 좀 놀라워요. 그리: It's also surprising that a spirit who guided travelers ended up like that. And then you came to our village?
Yes. I met a witch, following His Majesty's foresight.
strings.제가 %s의 여행을 처음부터 함께 한 게 아니라서 전부를 알 순 없지만…: I haven't accompanied you from the beginning of your journey, %s, so I can't know everything...
strings.앞으로도 필요한 일이 있다면 언제나 말해주세요. 최대한 도울게요. 마을: But if you need anything in the future, always tell me. I'll help as much as I can. I say that as the village's representative, so it may prove useful someday.
strings.고맙습니다. 소장님. 그런데, 여기 어떤 것 같으세요?: Thank you, Director. What do you think of this place?
strings.(리프가 조용히 눈을 감고 심호흡한다.): (Lif quietly closes her eyes and takes a deep breath.)
strings.이 공간이 특별한 느낌이 들긴 하지만, 마땅히 기운을 가져갈 수 있을만한: This place does feel special, but there aren't many plants from which we can take suitable energy.
The spirit energy seems concentrated over there. Let's go that way.
Oh, that's... toward the Spirit's Stump... Hmm...
strings.(정령의 그루터기 앞, %s의 기억 속에 무너졌다고 생각됐던 입구가 그대: (Before the Spirit's Stump, the entrance that %s remembered collapsing still stands intact.)
strings.(기아스와 하르모니아가 다시 정상으로 만든 걸까? 들어갈 수 있는 것 같: (Did Geis and Harmonia restore it? It seems we might be able to enter.)
strings.들어갈 수는 있지만…. 외부인을 허용하지 않은 정령들이 있어서 위험할 수: We can, but... There are spirits who don't allow outsiders. It could be dangerous.
If you say it's all right, I'll trust you. Follow me.
strings.(엘-라르사를 만났던 정령의 그루터기 제일 깊은 곳. 한때, 정령의 나무: (Deep within the Spirit's Stump, where you met Ell-Larsa, the remains of what was once the spirit tree greet you both.)
strings.%s 덕분에 이곳까지 잘 도착했네요. 이렇게 좋은 기운이 가득한 나무도: Thanks to you, %s, we made it all the way here. And we found a tree filled with such wonderful energy.
I'm glad we arrived without trouble.
strings.괴로움과 슬픔이 가득 남아있는 것 같아요. 어디든 그렇겠지만, 여기는 특: So much pain and sorrow seem to remain. Perhaps that is true everywhere, but here especially...
strings.이런 기분은 던져 버리고! 목적 달성해서 돌아가야죠!: Let's cast those feelings aside, achieve our goal, and return!
(As soon as she finishes speaking, Lif takes paper from her clothes and lays it on the stump. A mysterious light rises around it.)
strings.제가 도울 게 있을까요?: Is there anything I can do?
strings.(리프가 무릎을 꿇더니 눈을 감고 기도를 올린다. 그러자 종이 주위에서: (Lif kneels, closes her eyes, and prays. The light circling the paper gradually fades.)
strings.(알아들을 수 없는 말로 기도를 하셨네. 이제 된건가?): (She prayed in words I couldn't understand. Is it finished now?)
strings.다 됐어요. 이렇게 들어 올리면 좋은 기운이 그대로 이 종이에 남겨졌어요: All done. When I lift it like this, the good energy remains in the paper.
(As Lif lifts and unfolds the paper, the stump's growth rings appear clearly on it.)
The growth rings are imprinted exactly. Amazing.
strings.%s, 여기 우리 둘 말고 누가 또 있는 건 아니겠죠?: %s, there isn't anyone here besides the two of us, is there?
strings.아무도 없어요. 혹시 뭔가 느끼셨어요?: No one. Did you sense something?
strings.리프트라시르라면 금방 알아차릴 수 있을 텐데. 흐음. %s도 모르겠다면: If this were Lifthrasir, I would know at once. Hmm. If you don't know either, %s, then it can't be helped.
strings.(소장님도 그 그림자를 느낀 걸까? 그런 건 아닌 것 같았는데….): (Did she sense that shadow too? It didn't seem like that...)
Now, shall we return? You can sort out your thoughts back in Lifthrasir.
Thank you, %s. Everything worked out thanks to you.
strings.네? 리프트라시르로 돌아와서 아무것도 한 게 없는데요?: Pardon? We haven't done anything since returning to Lifthrasir.
strings.우리가 리프트라시르로 돌아왔을 때, 오르카리움에서 얻은 깨끗한 기운은 이: The moment we returned, the pure energy we obtained in Orcarium had already flowed into the Crystal Moon Forest.
strings.(리프가 나이테 탁본이었던 종이를 들어 보인다. 종이에 새겨진 나이테가: (Lif holds up the paper that bore the rubbing of the growth rings. The rings have vanished without a trace.)
strings.어, 진짜네요. 제한 구역의 식물들은 돌아왔을까요?: Oh, you're right. Have the plants in the restricted area recovered?
I don't think we need to go check right now.
Whew... It feels like it's been ages since I went outside Lifthrasir.
strings.그나저나 누가 그랬을까요?: But who could have done it?
strings.제가 느끼지 못할 정도로 수정달 숲에 손을 댔다면 역시 보통 사람은 아닐: Anyone who could tamper with the Crystal Moon Forest without my noticing must be extraordinary.
strings.아, 모르겠다. 일단 쉴래요. %s도 숙소에서 식사하고 쉬세요. 아셨죠?: Oh, I don't know. I'll rest for now. You should eat and rest at your lodgings too, %s. Understood?
Thanks to your kindness, I'll rest well, Director Lif. Don't worry.
Hehe. Then you'll spend your retirement here...
strings.저 아직 창창하거든요!: I still have my whole life ahead of me!
Yes, it must be wonderful to be so young. I'll be going in, then.
She got me good. Sigh. Time to get some rest...
strings.오랜만이야. 좀 더 반갑게 맞아줄 수는 없는 거야? 우리 보통 사이 아닌: It's been a while. Can't you greet me a little more warmly? Have you forgotten ours is no ordinary relationship?
strings.(제릴이 미소를 지은 채로 %s의 곁으로 다가간다. 그리고 잘 들리지 않: (Smiling, Jeril approaches %s and whispers his purpose so softly it is barely audible.)
strings.할 이야기가 있으니까 [사라진 별의 노래] 안으로 와. 혼자 조용히. 그: We need to talk. Come inside the [Vanished Song of the Stars]. Alone and quietly. Otherwise, who knows what I might do to you?
strings.(소년같이 순수했던 미소가 깊어져 잔혹함으로 느껴지는 순간, 옆에 있던: (The moment his boyishly innocent smile deepens into something cruel, Jeril scatters and vanishes like a shadow.)
What on earth does he want to say...?
strings.(사라진 별의 노래로 들어가자 제릴 말고도 낯설지 않은 사람 하나가 반갑: (Inside the Vanished Song of the Stars, another familiar person besides Jeril watches you with an unwelcoming expression.)
Were you the ones who contaminated the plants...?
strings.그런 일을 한 적도 없고, 하기도 싫다. 시간도 없고…. 이 이야기가 네: I have never done that, nor do I wish to. I have no time, either... I don't know whether this will answer your question.
strings.너라면 어렴풋이 느끼고 있었을 거야. 모습을 드러내고 있진 않지만, 그동: You must have sensed it vaguely. An ancient god who has remained hidden, yet has been obstructing your path and Iris's.
Awakened in the space of eternity, watching Iris...
That being does not wish its name to be spoken by sinners like us.
strings.(카즈노와 제릴이 조용히 하늘을 바라보자 방금 전까지도 보이지 않던 어둠: (As Kazno and Jeril silently look up at the sky, a darkness that was absent moments ago begins pouring in.)
strings.검은 달의 힘이 우리의 입을 막으려 해. 자세한 이야기는 곧 네가 갈 장: The black moon's power is trying to silence us. I'll meet you at the place you'll soon visit and explain the details there.
We cannot speak of it here now.
strings.아, %s. 우리 대신 할 일이 생겼는데 괜찮겠어?: Oh, %s. There's something you'll need to do for us. Is that all right?
If this darkness grows any thicker, the Vanished Song of the Stars will cease to exist. And then all of Lifthrasir...
strings.마녀와 관련된 자가 있었던 장소에 있는 물건을 찾아서 파괴해. 그것이라면: Find and destroy the objects in the places where those connected to the witch were. They should be able to send this darkness back.
It should be here and at the cathedral. Fascinating, though. A combination of demons and witches...
%s, I don't want your help, but we have no choice. Please survive.
Heh. That's what makes Kazno so charming. %s, farewell until we meet again.
strings.(카즈노와 제릴이 멋대로 안녕을 고하고 제자리에서 모습을 감춘다.): (Kazno and Jeril say their goodbyes on their own terms and vanish where they stand.)
The witches are already enough to deal with. Why must there be a god obstructing Iris too...?
strings.(원망 어린 목소리를 들은 것 같은 어둠이 점점 더 짙어진다.): (As though it has heard the resentful voice, the darkness deepens.)
Sigh. There's no time for this. Let's find those objects quickly.
strings.(사라진 별의 노래의 막다른 곳, 보라색으로 빛나는 작은 결정 하나가 반: (At a dead end in the Vanished Song of the Stars, a small purple crystal glitters.)
strings.강한 마력이 담겨 있는 것 같아. 멀린이 가지고 있던 건가?: It seems to contain powerful magic. Did it belong to Merlin?
strings.「신의 가호라고 해도 지금의 네 힘은 누군가의 죽음값으로 이뤄낸 힘일 것: 「Even if you call it a god's blessing, the power you possess now was gained at the cost of someone's death...」
Why am I remembering Merlin's words? Sigh... Ignore it and destroy this...
strings.(결정에 다가가려고 하는 순간, 주위에 검은 그림자가 방해하려는 것처럼: (The moment you approach the crystal, the surrounding black shadows move in as though to stop you. But %s's weapon shatters it first.)
strings.(결정이 파괴되자 언제 그랬냐는 것처럼 사라진 별의 노래를 맴돌던 짙은: (As the crystal breaks, the dense shadows circling the Vanished Song of the Stars scatter like dust and disappear as though they had never been.)
I don't know who commands these shadows, but things won't go your way...
strings.「차라리 죽음 앞에서 다른 위선자들처럼 목숨을 구걸해. 그게 더 괜찮은: 「At least beg for your life before death, like the other hypocrites. That would be a better choice.」
Ignore it. There's no time to stay here. Hurry to the cathedral.
Quickly... I have to get to the cathedral.
strings.(걱정을 안고 달려온 황혼의 성당, 아무도 없는지 고요함만이 가득하다.): (You rush anxiously to the Twilight Cathedral, but only silence fills it, as though no one is there.)
strings.그림자 같은 건 없군. 자, 모르가나와 관련된 물건이 있다면 빨리 찾아야: No shadows. All right. If there's something connected to Morgana, I need to find it quickly.
strings.설마 상층부 예배당까지 가야 되는 건 아니겠지?: Don't tell me I have to go all the way to the upper chapel?
I knew it wouldn't be easy. Let's go.
strings.(성당의 상층 구석에 있던 예배당, 모르가나와 싸웠던 장소 구석에서 모르: (In a corner of the upper chapel where you fought Morgana, you find a pendant that seems to belong to her.)
strings.…모르가나가 가지고 있던 펜던트는 분명 내가 파괴했는데. 왜 여기 하나: ...I definitely destroyed Morgana's pendant. Why is there another one here...? As though it had been waiting...
Sigh, I don't know. Just destroy the doll and pendant quickly...
strings.(낯설지 않은 인물 인형과 펜던트를 파괴하려고 하는 순간, 어디선가 짙은: (As you move to destroy the doll of a familiar figure and the pendant, dense shadows flow in from somewhere.)
strings.「당신이 믿었던 것이 한번에 무너질 수 있어요.」: 「Everything you believed in may collapse in an instant.」
...Now Morgana's voice too...? Don't get in my way.
strings.(모험가의 공격이 파괴를 막으려는 그림자에게 닿는 순간, 거대한 충격파가: (The moment the adventurer's attack strikes the shadow trying to prevent the destruction, an enormous shock wave shakes the silent cathedral.)
(As the dust filling the chapel settles, bright light streams through the windows. Raising your head, %s sees no trace of the doll or pendant.)
strings.다 된 건가? 아무것도 없으니까 이제 된 거겠지?: Is it done? There's nothing left, so it must be over, right?
strings.(돌아가려는 %s의 앞으로 커다란 그림자가 바닥에서부터 천천히 올라와 사: (As %s turns to leave, a vast shadow rises slowly from the floor and takes human form before you.)
strings.(그림자 속에서 알 수 없는 존재의 목소리가 흘러나오는 가운데, 언젠가: (From within the shadow comes the voice of an unknown being, mingled with the voice of someone you once heard.)
strings.「이 [▒▒]에서 죽어간 몬스터들이 과연 너에게는 당연히 사냥당해 마땅한: 「Were the monsters that died in this [▒▒] truly [▒] that you had every right to hunt?」
strings.「검은 달과 ▒▒, 그리고 밤을 기다리는 이들의 주인.」: 「Master of the black moon and ▒▒, and of those who await the night.」
strings.「그대는 신이 아니다. 그대는 그대가 죽는다는 것을 기억하라. 그것만 잊: 「You are no god. Remember that you will die. As long as you do not forget that, nothing will happen.」
strings.(그 말과 함께 세계의 모든 일그러진 감정이 가득 담긴 목소리가 더는 들: (With those words, the voice filled with all the world's twisted emotions falls silent. The shadows that filled the chapel withdraw and disappear as well.)
